text_block_list.text:
After being called by Mayano Top Gun,
I headed over to the dance studio, and—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
One, two, one, two!
Right here—

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: The "panther" pose!☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
...Mmuuuh~.
What am I doing wrong, I wonder~?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-chan!
Listen to this~!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The dance instructor told me
sexy choreography is still too early for Maya!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
She said you can't bring out the dance's charm
unless you're taller with more defined curves!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
How rude is that?!
Don't you think Maya's plenty sexy?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's show them what we're made of!
Yeah, let's show them what we're made of!
Why not try adding a little cuteness?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
How rude is that?!
Don't you think Maya's plenty sexy?!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's show them what we're made of!
Yeah, let's show them what we're made of!
Why not try adding a little cuteness?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yay~♪ I knew you'd say that,
Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Fufu!
Even Maya has a waistline to show off, you know~☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: If I'm too short, I can just stand on tiptoe!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: If I do it like this—hyawah?!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Owie~☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
T-That didn't count!
I'm gonna do it one more time, so watch!
choice_data_list: I don't think you need to push yourself to act grown-up.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Fueh?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, come on, Trainer-chan,
stop iiiiiit!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't that, isn't that...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
"You mean, 'I love you just the way you are☆'?
Eeeeeeeek!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Maya's really, totally super-duper loved
by Trainer-chan, huh~♪

There seemed to be a bit of a misunderstanding,
but Mayano Top Gun appeared to be in high spirits.
Afterward, Mayano Top Gun continued practicing, and apparently succeeded in making the dance instructor admit, "Well, this works in its own way."

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Mmmh~...!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Wait, are you just like Sensei, Trainer-chan?!
You think sexy is too soon for Maya?!
I defended myself by saying that blending cuteness with sexiness would better bring out Mayano Top Gun's strengths.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I see, I see...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
In other words, Maya's charms don't stop
at just being sexy!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
So that's how it is!
Trainer-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Then come help me
come up with choreography now☆

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Let's come up with a dance together
that shows off all of Maya's charm♪

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: "With you, Trainer-chan, we're sure to create a masterpiece that'll blow the teacher away!"

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
As for the theme~
...Taking Off into Adulthood! ☆
Afterward, I worked with Mayano Top Gun to come up with dance choreography.

Later on, Mayano Top Gun performed her new dance
for the teacher in question and received high praise.
